'''Scrubber brushes''' were large, abrasive cleaning brushes. Each [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] was equipped with three scrubber brushes mounted on its underside. Standing at a height three times that of a standard [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], the scrubber brushes were due to clean streets and avenues. The scrubbers were supplemented with an array of fourteen [[beamcleaner]]s which provided precise scouring power.<ref name="EGTD" />
